flow.name: 05 · Webhook echo
flow.notes: Listens on the local HTTP server at path /hook/echo and posts a notification echoing the method + body. Tests the Webhook trigger and webhook.* magic-text bindings. Once enabled, trigger from another shell: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8821/hook/echo --data 'hello'. For remote testing, set up adb reverse tcp:8821 tcp:8821 then call from your desktop.
